I couldn’t stay at this hostel because I found bedbugs in the room. After only a few minutes of lying on the bed, my whole body started itching. When I turned the lights on, I found bedbugs on the bedding, and one was even on my body.

I left the room and had to find another place to stay. The receptionist was nice and respectful, but this is a serious hygiene problem that cannot be ignored. I would not recommend staying here unless the issue is properly treated.
